title: Polygons, Circles and Area: cheat sheet

blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Polygons and circles are measured with a few formulas. Break complicated shapes into triangles, rectangles and sectors, and add or subtract areas.

blocks.title: Quadrilaterals
items: Parallelogram: opposite sides parallel and equal
Rectangle: four right angles, equal diagonals
Rhombus: four equal sides, perpendicular diagonals
Square: rectangle and rhombus in one
Trapezoid: one pair of parallel sides

blocks.title: Sector
blocks.body: Arc length $=\frac{\theta}{360}\cdot2\pi r$ and area $=\frac{\theta}{360}\cdot\pi r^2$

blocks.title: Circle angles
items: Inscribed angle is half its arc

blocks.body: Area uses square units. Doubling a length multiplies area by 4.
